name: yhs_can_control.launch
preconditions: CAN up and remote mode ready

name: move_base
risks: Do not use before localization initialized and unlock/safety state is valid

name: /move_base_simple/goal
preconditions: nav stack running and map localization initialized
risks: Frame mismatch changes target meaning; current gateway should use map frame

name: /move_base/cancel
risks: Cancel alone is not a hardware e-stop; pair with state monitoring

name: /cmd_vel
preconditions: CAN driver and velocity smoother running
typical_use: Planner raw velocity or zero-stop command
risks: Do not expose arbitrary velocity commands to center; reserve for local stop gate

name: /smoother_cmd_vel
preconditions: CAN driver running and command mode enabled
risks: High-risk low-level interface; gateway should not use it for task goals

name: /chassis_info_fb
risks: Message type is FW-specific for this vehicle; other chassis types differ

name: /odom
risks: In 3D/NDT launch odom topic exists but odom-to-base_link TF is disabled

name: /imu_data
risks: Serial device mapping must be checked per vehicle

name: map-to-base_link TF

name: /scan1
risks: Only present if camera obstacle layer enabled

name: /scan3
risks: Depends on ultrasonic configuration and chassis feedback

name: /recharge

risks: Not launched by default yhs_nav.launch; front path must be clear
